answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7748 Country: India Title: I would like you to explain about NIMAZ after a Barelwi Imam? Question: Aslaam U Alaikum Wa Rehmatullahi Wa Barakatahu Respectes Ulemas I would like you to explain about NIMAZ after a Barelwi Imam? Waiting for reply KHUDA HAFIZ Answer ID: 7748 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1221/207=L/1429) If that Barelvi Imam is not having beliefs of shirk then it is only makrooh-e-tahrimi to pray salah behind him. If there is no nearby mosque of Muslims having correct beliefs then one should perform salah behind that Barelvi Imam, he will get the reward of Jamat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
